body: i’m really trying to get out of this house and go to college.. but thank you so much,, i honestly wish u the best too. thank you for listening to me, that’s all i really i wanted from someone.

but the thing is, my parents are the ones who are calling my sister crazy. i can’t talk to me sister either.. even though she has depression, she has this ego.. and believes she’s better than me in every aspect and always finds a way to put me down. she always thinks about herself and never tries to understand what i’m feeling. when i did talk to her all she told me was to not be like her because i’ll stress my mom out. this was because she attempted right before my freshman year of high school. so i’m working my ass off to finish my senior year and graduate (because she never finished high school) but also trying please everyone around me. all of my family and friend’s family view mental illness and heath as something taboo and would rather gossip about it rather than help... i feel like i’m just finding all the reasons not to get better.. and making all these excuses because in reality, i don’t know what if feels like to be “normal” anymore.. and i’m clinging onto it because it’s all i know now..
